Actual recovery-to-trace and both-direction propagation with empty/accepted providers
Existing APIs equivalent outputs and provider counts
Actual native model wrapper/diagnostic output and current corpus qualification
limits: Root untouched; historical96 cases cannot be retroactively attributed
240-byte result layout is platform-specific, not a hard process-memory cap
